sources.title: Xero OAuth 2.0 overview
notes: Xero supports authorization code and PKCE flows.
PKCE is the right installed-app path when a client secret cannot be safely stored.
Code and PKCE apps connect to up to 25 tenants before certification.

sources.title: Xero OAuth token types
notes: Access tokens are valid for up to 30 minutes.
Refresh tokens require offline_access, are valid for up to 60 days, and rotate on refresh.
PKCE token refresh does not require a client secret.
A lost refresh response leaves a previous refresh token grace period of up to 30 minutes.

sources.title: Xero OAuth 2.0 FAQ
notes: Unused refresh tokens expire after 60 days.
Access tokens expire after 30 minutes.
Wildcard redirect URIs are not supported.

sources.title: Xero limits FAQ
notes: Concurrent tenant limit is 5 calls in progress.
Tenant minute limit is 60 calls per minute.
Tenant daily limit is 5000 calls per day.
App minute limit is 10000 calls per minute across tenants.
Rate-limit responses include remaining-limit headers and 429 responses include Retry-After.

sources.title: Xero developer pricing and tiers
notes: Starter tier currently shows 1000 API calls per day per organisation.
Core and higher tiers currently show 5000 API calls per day per organisation.
Developer dashboard usage and connection metering is app-level.

sources.title: Xero official MCP server
notes: Official MCP supports Custom Connections using client ID and client secret.
Official MCP supports pre-supplied bearer tokens.
The local plugin wraps the official MCP client so installed users do not need developer credentials or a manually supplied short-lived bearer token.
